quest.title: "Owl Musician"
quest.description: You encounter a serious guard in Constellation Metropole...

dialogues.speaker: Alof
dialogues.text: My colleagues have apprised me of your names and deeds, and have confirmed that you are valiant indeed.

dialogues.speaker: Alof
dialogues.text: Were I not in charge of training the guards, I should have liked to spar with you.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So you're a guard yourself, then?

dialogues.speaker: Alof
dialogues.text: In sooth, I am. On the orders of our liege, we are to defend Constellation Metropole and keep the peace.

dialogues.speaker: Alof
dialogues.text: My work, specifically, is to train the guards, that their skills may prove worthy of their duty.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So the door behind leads to the training grounds?

dialogues.speaker: Alof
dialogues.text: Keen-eyed indeed! It leads to a Domain that we just finished remodeling.

dialogues.speaker: Alof
dialogues.text: Within those grounds, the trainee must swing their blade to a specific rhythm, and the arena's lighting will constantly change throughout the battle.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Sounds like some pretty rigorous training...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Sounds complicated, more like... Do you have to follow that specific rhythm while fighting as well?

dialogues.speaker: Alof
dialogues.text: This part of the regimen is actually derived from a story titled "The Owl Musician."

dialogues.speaker: Alof
dialogues.text: It was popular amongst the guards some time back. Many enjoyed it to the point where they'd forget to take part in training, and their daily patrols were delayed.

dialogues.speaker: Alof
dialogues.text: But I had a thought. Since everyone liked it so much, adding elements of the story into our training would make it more enjoyable.

dialogues.speaker: Alof
dialogues.text: It has had a visible effect on training... if nothing else, there have been no further delays in our patrols due to personal reasons.

dialogues.speaker: Alof
dialogues.text: Hehe... Would the two of you be interested in said training?

dialogues.speaker: Alof
dialogues.text: The challenges within should be a piece of cake for those with valor such as yours.

choices.text: I'd love to give it a try!

response.speaker: Alof
response.text: Such commendable courage! Excellent. Please, then, step into the Domain.

choices.text: I've got other things going on right now...

response.speaker: Alof
response.text: Understandable. Come back whenever you have the time — I will be standing guard here.
